name: Sentence Families
description: Core structural patterns that define how a sentence delivers its payload

negation_pivot.name: Negation Pivot
negation_pivot.description: Negates an assumption then pivots to the real point
failureModes: Weak if the negation isn't surprising
examples: The problem isn't resources—it's coordination.
Leadership isn't about control—it's about clarity.

colon_reveal.name: Colon Reveal
colon_reveal.description: Builds anticipation then delivers via colon
failureModes: Flat if setup is too short
examples: Here's what nobody tells you: the hardest part is starting.
The answer was simple: stop optimizing.

em_dash_insert.name: Em-Dash Insert
em_dash_insert.description: Interrupts main flow with a sharp aside
failureModes: Choppy if insert is too long
Confusing if main clause is already complex
examples: The team—and this is critical—hadn't been consulted.
She knew—everyone knew—that it wouldn't work.

question_answer.name: Question-Answer
question_answer.description: Poses then immediately answers a question
failureModes: Can feel rhetorical/cheap if question is obvious
examples: Why did it fail? Because nobody owned it.
What changed? Everything.

list_resolve.name: List Resolve
list_resolve.description: Enumerates then resolves with a point
failureModes: Tedious if items aren't carefully chosen
Weak if resolution doesn't earn the buildup
examples: Meetings, emails, and status updates: the trifecta of wasted time.
Speed, simplicity, and focus: that's the whole strategy.

contrast_pair.name: Contrast Pair
contrast_pair.description: Juxtaposes two things to highlight difference
examples: Amateurs focus on tactics; professionals focus on systems.
The old way was safe; the new way is necessary.

conditional_snap.name: Conditional Snap
conditional_snap.description: Sets up a condition then delivers a punchy result
failureModes: Weak if consequence is too soft
examples: If you can't explain it simply, you don't understand it.
When the metrics become the goal, they cease to be good metrics.

definition_is.name: Definition-Is
examples: Strategy is saying no.
Trust is the ultimate efficiency.

analogy_bridge.name: Analogy Bridge
analogy_bridge.description: Uses analogy to bridge abstract to concrete
failureModes: Can feel cheesy if analogy is strained
examples: Writing code is like writing prose: clarity beats cleverness.
Think of culture like an operating system: invisible but runs everything.

parallel_triple.name: Parallel Triple
parallel_triple.description: Three parallel phrases building to emphasis
failureModes: Loses power if phrases aren't truly parallel
examples: Show up. Do the work. Ship it.
We came. We saw. We shipped.

reversal_but.name: Reversal But
reversal_but.description: Sets up expectation then reverses with 'but'
failureModes: Weak if reversal isn't actually surprising
examples: I thought we needed more data, but we needed less.
Everyone expected failure, but something else happened.

accumulation.name: Accumulation
accumulation.template: [Long sentence building through multiple clauses to a point].
failureModes: Can lose reader if too long
examples: The meetings piled up, the deadlines slipped, the stakeholders grew restless, and still nobody made a decision.

understatement.name: Understatement
failureModes: Misses if reader doesn't catch it
examples: The results were not entirely what we'd hoped.
That approach has some challenges.

direct_command.name: Direct Command
examples: Ship it.
Stop optimizing. Start executing.

fragment_punch.name: Fragment Punch
fragment_punch.description: Follows a full sentence with a punchy fragment
examples: We tried everything. Nothing worked.
They said it couldn't be done. It could.

extended_qualifier.name: Extended Qualifier
extended_qualifier.description: Wraps the main point in multiple qualifications
examples: While the evidence is mixed, and reasonable people disagree, the core insight holds.
